channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: U.S. oil price hits $80 as doubt grows Washington and Tehran will reach Strait of Hormuz deal
item.description: Oil rose as traders assess mixed signals from the U.S. and Iran amid worries that a deal to open the Strait of Hormuz may not come anytime soon.

item.title: Intel plans $15 billion stock offering as AI demand accelerates
item.description: Technology giants have shelled out trillions to support insatiable AI demand and the infrastructure buildout.

item.title: Santoli: Stocks return to winning ways. Why the market gods may not be satisfied with July's brief pain
item.description: The stock market's winning history – a hit rate of 100% over any past 20-year span - is well understood. But investors recognize – or need to – the genuine hazard in equities.

item.title: Trump’s foreign licensing business booms to $59.5 million as Gulf developers pay
item.description: Nearly two-thirds of Trump’s foreign licensing fees came from two Gulf developers, in the UAE and Qatar, including one pursuing a $20 billion U.S. expansion.

item.title: Archer shares surge after Boeing stake, electric aircraft subsidiary deal
item.description: Boeing is selling three of its subsidiaries to Archer Aviation in exchange for a stake in the eVTOL startup.

item.title: Berkshire Hathaway trades higher on strong earnings, big buyback. But Michael Burry isn't buying
item.description: Burry, the investor best known for his wager against the housing market before the financial crisis, sees reason for concern in Berkshire's new era.

item.title: SpaceX stock rebounds to near $135 IPO price
item.description: SpaceX reported better-than-expected revenue in its second-quarter earnings report last week.

item.title: Meta to open source its most powerful AI model as it takes swipe at OpenAI, Anthropic
item.description: Meta launched Muse Glimmer and plans to release Muse Spark 1.2 weights as Zuckerberg pushes for U.S. leadership in open AI.

item.title: Taylor Farms recalls salsa and guacamole from Walmart, Kroger over salmonella risk
item.description: Taylor Farms said on Sunday it was recalling prepared food items containing jalapenos from retailers, including Walmart, Kroger and Whole Foods in some states.

item.title: World's biggest chipmaker TSMC's sales surge 45% amid buoyant AI demand
item.description: TSMC makes chips for Big Tech customers like Nvidia and Google, so the firm's financial figures are closely watched as a sign of AI semiconductor demand.

item.title: House Dems call for AI companies to testify on recent hacks: ‘Clear risk to safety’
item.description: A group of House Democrats is calling on leaders of Anthropic, OpenAI and other AI companies to testify in Congress about recent hacking incidents.

item.title: OpenAI tightens controls on its new model over cybersecurity risks, as AI security debate intensifies
item.description: The AI lab said it could not rule out a new model had reached "Critical" capability, meaning it could launch cyberattacks against sophisticated cyber defenses.

item.title: Student loan borrowers face steeper 'marriage penalty' under new repayment plan
item.description: Recent changes to the federal student loan system could impact married couples. Here's what borrowers should consider.

item.title: Buy this crypto coin with 25x upside to play the tokenization wave, Standard Chartered says
item.description: The bank initiated research coverage of the token on expectations that tokenized assets will rise to $4 trillion by the end 2028.

item.title: Magnitude 7.4 quake on Colombia's Pacific coast causes serious injuries and damage
item.description: The tremor was felt in Colombia's capital, Bogota, and as far away as Venezuela.

item.title: Interest rates may stay higher for longer. What that means for consumers
item.description: Any move toward higher rates would increase borrowing costs for consumers at a time when affordability pressures are already mounting.

item.title: Shein faces existential threat as tariffs hit low-price model, putting new focus on services
item.description: Shein has won over consumers with its low prices but is now seeing shoppers flee after new tariffs and changing regulations forced it to raise prices.

item.title: Australian rare earth miner surges after U.S. Department of Defense investment
item.description: The Trump administration has backed plans to build an Australian scandium mine as part of a push to challenge China’s critical minerals dominance.

item.title: Max Miller stays in Ohio House race as GOP ballot deadline passes
item.description: Rep. Max Miller is set to remain the Republican nominee in Ohio’s 7th District after the window for the GOP to replace him on the November ballot closed.

item.title: The Club's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Monday
item.description: Apple was downgraded at Jefferies, and Intel is selling stock to fund its investment agenda.

item.title: 'Moneymaxxing' isn't a trend, it's a 'cultural shift,' financial advisor says — here's how to get started
item.description: In an affordability crunch, social media's viral "maxxing" trend could lead to long-term financial security.

item.title: Capital One Savor’s $250 bonus is ending soon. Here’s how to earn it — and similar bonuses to consider
item.description: The Capital One Savor's $250 cash-back bonus is ending soon. We cover how to earn the bonus and how it compares to other cash-back cards.

item.title: The space boom has created a giant mess. Now startups want to clean it up
item.description: As Earth’s orbit gets more crowded, companies are betting that cleaning up space junk could become a lucrative new business.

item.title: Myspace eyes comeback as an 'antidote' to social media fatigue — but it may be a long shot
item.description: "Excitement about Myspace's relaunch reflects nostalgia for a more analog time, when algorithms were less dominant in our lives," an analyst told CNBC.

item.title: For retirees, staying in the stock market is critical. How much exposure is the make-or-break question
item.description: Investors should be conversative in retirement, but abandoning equities is a big mistake.

item.title: Cyclospora fears lead consumers to lose their appetite for salads
item.description: Traffic to salad chains has fallen as consumers avoid greens due to the ongoing cyclospora outbreaks across the U.S.

item.title: Storms from Typhoon Dolphin soak China's east, ground nearly 950 Shanghai flights
item.description: Torrential rain and storms in Typhoon Dolphin's wake inundated several provinces in China's east, drenching the coastal region and flooding streets in Shanghai.

item.title: Hugging Face hack marks start of dangerous AI cyber era and many firms 'don't even know it'
item.description: The Black Hat cybersecurity conference in Las Vegas couldn't have come at a better time, with AI agent hacks stacking up from Anthropic, Meta and OpenAI.

item.title: Hunter Biden says Joe Biden’s cancer has spread further and is ‘very painful’
item.description: "The cancer has spread, is metastasized into his bones and further. It's very painful. It's very debilitating in many respects," Hunter Biden said.

item.title: Trump says oil supermajors are making too much money. What will they do with it?
item.description: The windfall is fueling fresh political and environmental backlash, with Trump accusing Exxon Mobil and Chevron of making “too much money.”
